The risk band also considers egress location: mainland China egress sets a high band. The actual Claude egress takes priority; this site's egress is a fallback reference and may differ under split routing. An unknown country prevents a complete band. This is not an official Claude verdict or ban probability; the Emoji check uses UA inference.
